channel.title: NeuroTrailblazers: Experimental Podcast with Will and Julian
channel.description: Four short family discussions about connectomics and NIH BRAIN CONNECTS, performed with AI-generated versions of Will and Julian’s voices.
channel.itunes:author: NeuroTrailblazers

item.title: What is connectomics?
item.description: What brain cells do, why their connections matter, and what a map can and cannot tell us. Scripted discussion with AI-generated voices.

item.title: What is NIH BRAIN CONNECTS?
item.description: How the National Institutes of Health (NIH) BRAIN CONNECTS program supports the tools needed to map brain connections, and how to judge progress. Scripted discussion with AI-generated voices.

item.title: How do you make a brain map?
item.description: Follow a piece of preserved brain tissue through preparation, imaging, computer tracing, and human checking. Scripted discussion with AI-generated voices.

item.title: How can I get involved?
item.description: Small, concrete starting points for children, school and university students, and adults following the science. Scripted discussion with AI-generated voices.
